question: At what nighttime moment and location should the mantra be recited?
premises: The time is after ten daṇḍas have passed at night.
The location is on the bed.
inference: When ten daṇḍas have passed at night, one should recite the mantra on the bed.
plain_english: When ten daṇḍas have passed at night, one should recite the mantra on the bed.
